hypothesis: Empirical repair gold is menu-relative: the same (task, screen) case has different gold under two disclosed menus. Therefore no menu-blind κ — a function of (Y, q) of any signature width — matches gold on both menus. The frozen five-field rule's collision and its correctness are themselves menu-relative. κ_screen, recomputed per menu, stays exact.

controls.description: κ_cheap is Paper E's decide imported unmodified. No refit to the known miss, per the close-out prohibition.
Menus, screens, tasks, and cases are written in core.py before gold_of_menu is evaluated.
Base-menu gold for the 11 imported Paper E cases must equal Paper E's gold_of exactly.
Reversal relabel is checked at the action layer and the chosen-screen layer separately; a tie-break failure is recorded, not hidden.
menu_blind_dead, menu_blind_lives, no_function, and inconclusive are all valid passing runs.

gates.criterion: Menus, maps, tasks, and cases are specified in the module before the run.
17 case specs, 34 (case, menu) rows, the 11 Paper E cases included unchanged.
MENU_BASE is a prefix of MENU_EXT and the extension is exactly {q_pair01, q_pair23}.
Signatures are exactly the Paper E five fields on every row.
Base-menu gold equals Paper E gold on the 11 registered cases.
The per-case gold flip table is recorded.
κ_screen never returns broken on any row of either menu.
Reversal relabel preserves the action on every registered pair.
Chosen-screen naturality is recorded; failures list their witnesses.
Verdict is menu_blind_dead, menu_blind_lives, no_function, or inconclusive.
No new master object, no LLM eval, no cheap-rule refit, no text nomination.
